newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA AVERAGE NET WAGE 14 PCT UP IN DECEMBER.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA AVERAGE NET WAGE 14 PCT UP IN DECEMBER.

text.p: The average net wage in Romania rose by 14 percent last December from the previous month, a rise well above the month's 10.3 percent inflation, a National Statistics Board report showed on Tuesday.
It said the average net wage was 433,692 lei in December, while the monthly net wage average in 1996 as a whole was 321,987 lei, 49.3 percent higher than in the previous year.
Purchasing power last year rose by 7.6 percent from 1995 and was 71.5 percent of the 1990 level, the report said.
It said employees in the financial sector had had the highest net wage of 999,017 lei on an average in December, with workers in the health and social security sectors paid the lowest at 304,657 lei.
Romania employed 5.63 million people at end-December, some 11,000 less than in November.
